trophies.guide: This is the platinum, and it pops only after the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to chase. Work the roadmap in order: finish the five-chapter story, protect the one possibly missable meditation in Chapter 1, then clear collectibles, activities and the 100% checklist. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours, all offline, in a single playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, and the trophy unlocks automatically when it ends. Just follow the on-screen objectives and the story beats as they come; nothing here can be missed and there is no extra condition to meet. It is the first story trophy of the run, so treat it as the starting point and keep playing into Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full, playing its missions in story order until the chapter closes, and this bronze unlocks on its own. Story trophies cannot be missed, since the chapter must be completed to reach the rest of the game, and there is no mission replay to worry about. Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house, the one step PowerPyx flags as possibly missable.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2, playing through its missions in order until the chapter ends, and this bronze pops automatically. Like every chapter trophy it cannot be missed, because the story must move through this chapter to continue. From here both Jason and Lucia are playable, so meditation spots and other two-character tasks can be worked on with either of them as you travel.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full and this bronze unlocks when the chapter closes. It is an automatic story trophy, so there is no side task, no special condition and no way to miss it; simply keep playing the main missions in order. By now Vice City itself is open to you, so use the travel between missions to scan vehicles and landmarks with WAiNK.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale, and this bronze pops when it ends. It unlocks automatically from story progress alone, with no extra objective and nothing missable attached. With the end of the story in sight, finish any stranger mission strands you have open, since one guide warns some strands close as the story advances, though that is not yet confirmed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story and this gold trophy unlocks when the credits roll. It is automatic story progress, so there is no extra condition, no choice to get wrong and nothing to miss. Once the story is done, free roam stays open and the 100% completion checklist appears under Progress, so the long cleanup stage of the platinum run can begin.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run and this bronze unlocks when it ends. It is an automatic story trophy, so just play the mission through its objectives as they appear; there is no extra condition and nothing that can be missed. Mission names like this one are the story trophies the spoiler setting hides until they are earned, so the guide keeps the detail to the mission itself.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist and this bronze pops when the mission ends. It is automatic story progress with no side objective, so play the heist through its beats as directed and the trophy follows on its own. Heist missions are story milestones, so this one cannot be missed or failed permanently; a failed attempt can simply be retried from the mission start.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play and this bronze unlocks at the mission's end. It is an automatic story trophy, so there is no extra step beyond finishing the mission itself, and nothing about it can be missed. Keep playing the main story in order and it will come naturally; the trophy is one of the twelve story trophies that unlock simply by reaching each story beat.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners and this bronze pops when the mission ends. It is automatic story progress, so play the mission through and the trophy unlocks on its own, with no side condition and nothing missable. The mission's name is a story spoiler, which is why the app's spoiler setting hides this trophy's name and description until you have earned it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown and this bronze unlocks when it ends. It is automatic story progress, so there is no extra objective to chase and nothing that can be missed; just finish the mission. The mission takes place around Vice City International Airport, so the airport itself becomes familiar ground for the separate VCIA trophy about making an unscheduled departure.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory and this bronze pops at the mission's end. It is automatic story progress with no extra condition, so play the mission through and the trophy follows; nothing here can be missed. It is one of the later story trophies, so by the time it unlocks you will be well into the five-chapter story and close to the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion by finishing the in-game checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, only after the story ends. The checklist has 35 requirements and most need only part of a set, such as 15 of 18 card sets and 70 of 80 challenges, so it is roughly 60% of true completion per PowerPyx. It is the hardest trophy and the last big step before platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind across Leonida, counting stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps, and the silver pops at 250. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total and the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy if you want the platinum. Stunts happen naturally while driving and flying, but dedicated stunt jumps are the fastest way to farm the count.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once, covering all nine activity types the game offers, and this bronze pops when the last type is tried. You only need to sample each one, not win or master it, so work through the list early in the story and tick types off as they appear. It is a taster for the deeper activity trophies that follow.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, and this silver pops when the last gold lands. The two ranges are Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero, and the same 42 golds are needed for 100% completion, so this is the hardest skill requirement on the checklist.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location, covering all 14 locations, and this bronze pops when the last one is won. Each location also holds drone time trials, three per location for 42 in total, and all 42 are needed for 100% completion, so the racing and the trials share the same trips. Repeat a location until the win registers.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida and this bronze pops at the twentieth distinct win. Different means different events, so repeating one race you like does not move the count; spread your wins across race types and locations instead. Races count toward the activity side of the game, and the gold medals from race challenges are a separate 100% checklist item, so treat wins and medals as two jobs.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge and this bronze pops when the challenge ends in your favour. Fishing challenges are one of the game's activities, so find Cal at a fishing spot, take the challenge and out-fish him on the day's catch. The exact spot and scoring are not yet confirmed in-game, so treat the first attempt as a scouting run.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game, any one of them, and this bronze pops when it ends. Arcade games are one of the activity types, so step up to a cabinet, play it through to its end and the trophy follows. It needs only a single completion, not a high score, so pick the shortest or easiest game you find and finish it; cabinet locations are not yet confirmed in-game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, the last job in his stranger mission strand, and this bronze pops when it ends. Stranger strands unlock as the story advances, so take Andy's missions when they appear and follow the strand to its end. One guide warns some stranger strands can close as the story moves on, which is not yet confirmed, so do not leave Andy's strand sitting unfinished for long.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, the last job in his stranger mission strand, and this bronze pops when it ends. Kenton's strand is tied to diving and treasure around Key Lento, so follow his missions to the end. One guide warns some stranger strands can close as the story moves on, which is not yet confirmed, so do not leave Kenton's strand sitting unfinished for long.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, the last job in his stranger mission strand, and this bronze pops when it ends. Stranger strands unlock as the story advances, so take Billy's missions when they appear and follow the strand to its end. One guide warns some stranger strands can close as the story moves on, which is not yet confirmed, so do not leave Billy's strand sitting unfinished for long.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida and this silver pops when the eighth strand ends. Stranger missions appear as the story advances, so work through them alongside the main missions rather than leaving them all to the end. Five of the strands end in their own named trophies for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, so those five count toward the eight.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, the last job in his stranger mission strand, and this bronze pops when it ends. Stranger strands unlock as the story advances, so take Randy's missions when they appear and follow the strand to its end. One guide warns some stranger strands can close as the story moves on, which is not yet confirmed, so do not leave Randy's strand sitting unfinished for long.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, the last job in his stranger mission strand, and this bronze pops when it ends. Stranger strands unlock as the story advances, so take Tyrone's missions when they appear and follow the strand to its end. One guide warns some stranger strands can close as the story moves on, which is not yet confirmed, so do not leave Tyrone's strand sitting unfinished for long.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida, all 18 meditation spots at 10 locations, and this bronze pops when the last one is done. Progress is tracked in the Collections section of the Progress menu. Do the first one in Chapter 1, on the balcony at Jason's house after the Down to Earth mission, because PowerPyx says it becomes unavailable after that chapter, though whether it counts is not yet confirmed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret and this bronze pops when the hunt ends. Bret's strand is one of the stranger missions, so take it when it appears and follow it until the unique animal is found. The animal's species and hunting ground are not yet confirmed in-game by the guides, so treat the strand's own directions as your map and keep a rifle ready for a shot at range.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets and this silver pops when the third set is finished. There are 18 sets holding 480 cards in total, so any three complete sets will do, and the 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so keep collecting past this trophy. Track sets under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards, and work one set at a time rather than scattering your finds across all eighteen.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations, scanning landmarks, curiosities and sculptures with the WAiNK app on your phone, and this silver pops at the hundredth scan. Hold Up to open the phone app, scan on foot, and check progress under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations. Push Square counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, so there are more than enough spots to reach 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges and this bronze pops at the fiftieth. There are 80 challenges in total across eight kinds, from combat to shopping, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so keep going past this trophy if you want the platinum. Track them under Progress, then Challenges, pick off the easy ones first, and let the count build naturally while you work on the other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat, and this bronze pops when the heat is off. Build four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears, keeping your partner with you. The exact partner is not yet confirmed in-game, so use the usual wanted-level tricks of hiding and distance.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level, and this bronze pops after the third shop. Keep the wanted level alive across all three robberies, so move fast between shops, keep your partner close, and do not let the heat drop or the run ends. The exact shop types are not yet confirmed in-game, so pick three close together and plan the route first.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles and this bronze pops at the hundredth. GTABase says to scan different vehicles with the WAiNK app without driving them, and busy roads are the efficient place to find new ones. Track progress under Progress, then Vehicles, and keep scanning as you travel; the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so this trophy is only halfway to that count.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus and this bronze pops when the fifth falls. Combat Focus is the game's aiming mode, so trigger it in a busy fight, pick your targets fast and land five takedowns before the effect ends. A crowded shootout is the best place to try it, and a failed attempt costs nothing, so keep retrying until five fall in one use.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City International Airport, and this bronze pops when you leave by a way the airport never scheduled. The exact departure is not yet confirmed in-game, so the working idea is to take a plane from the airport outside any mission or booked flight. Treat the first attempt as a scouting run and try another aircraft if it does not pop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos, so this bronze is about the Rhino tanks, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game. The working idea, from the trophy's own wording, is to get into a Rhino tank or take one on, so look for Rhinos at military or high-wanted-level spots and try both riding one and fighting one. Treat the first attempt as a scouting run.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected and this bronze pops when you get away clean. Plan the robbery, move quietly, avoid the cameras and guards, and leave without raising an alarm; being spotted at any point should fail the attempt. The exact store and approach are not yet confirmed in-game, so scout the store first, save before you start, and retry if you are seen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape, and this silver pops after the fifth clean getaway. Bank vault robberies are repeatable open-world jobs, so plan each one, get in and out fast, and lose the wanted level before the next attempt. The exact vault locations and approach are not yet confirmed in-game, so scout each bank first and treat the first vault as a scouting run.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape, and this bronze pops when you get away after the robbery. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida, so find one, stop it, take the cash and lose the wanted level that follows. The exact method is not yet confirmed in-game, so try blocking the truck or forcing the driver out, and treat the first attempt as a scouting run.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida, all 52 areas of the state, and this bronze pops when the last area registers. Travel the map steadily as the story opens new ground, and check progress under Progress to see which areas are still unvisited. Areas count when you enter them, so drive through the gaps on the map and finish the stragglers in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang, one operation for each of the 9 gangs, and this bronze pops when the last gang's operation is robbed. Illegal operations are gang-held sites around Leonida, so find each gang's turf, hit its operation and get away. The exact sites are not yet confirmed in-game, so use the map and the game's own markers to find each gang's operation in turn.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, and this bronze pops when the moment lands. The trophy's own wording points to a drink with an ocean view on Ocean Beach, so find a beachfront bar there and order a cocktail. The exact spot and trigger are not yet confirmed in-game, so treat the first visit as a scouting run and try the beachfront bars in turn.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, and this bronze pops when you break out. The trophy's own wording points to driving a car straight through a showroom's glass front, so find a vehicle showroom, get a car inside and smash out through the front. The exact showroom and approach are not yet confirmed in-game, so treat the first attempt as a scouting run.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley, and this bronze pops when the bowling moment lands. The trophy's own wording points to that alley, so go there, play a frame and follow through on the throw. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game, so treat the first visit as a scouting run and try a full game if one throw does not pop it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal, and this bronze pops when the partnership moment lands, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game by the guides. The trophy's own wording suggests a moment with Jason and Lucia that draws a crowd or goes public, so keep an eye out during partner missions and open-world moments together. Treat any promising moment as a scouting run and note what the game counts.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse, and this bronze is about the choices you make, with the PlayStation tracker counting choices up to 500. Play the story and the stranger strands, make the choices the game offers, and the trophy should pop as the count builds. The exact choices that count are not yet confirmed in-game, so treat this as a background trophy that fills in as you play.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm, and this bronze pops when a second attempt succeeds, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game by the guides. The trophy's own wording suggests failing something once and then succeeding on the retry, so watch for moments where the game lets you try again after a failure. Treat any retry that succeeds as a possible trigger and note what the game counts.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened, and this bronze pops when you witness something strange, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game by the guides. The trophy's own wording points to one of the game's odd open-world encounters, so keep an eye out while exploring Leonida, especially in remote or unusual spots. Treat any strange encounter as a possible trigger and note where it happened.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by, and this bronze pops when the drive-by lands, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed in-game by the guides. The trophy's own wording points to knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, so try a melee swing at a pedestrian as you drive past. Treat the first attempt as a scouting run and note what the game counts.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts, and this bronze pops when the laundered total reaches a quarter of a million. Marked Bills come from robberies, so launder them through your contacts as you earn them rather than letting them pile up. The exact contacts and rates are not yet confirmed in-game, so use the contacts the game offers and track the total as it builds.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops and this bronze pops when total spending reaches six figures. Shops cover clothes, weapons, vehicles and more, so the total builds naturally as you gear up through the story and the cleanup. Track it as background spending rather than a grind, and buy the gear and upgrades you actually want, since every shop purchase counts toward the same total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties, all 8 of them, and this bronze pops when the last garage is bought. Garages are properties you buy around Leonida, so earn the money through missions and robberies, then buy each garage as you can afford it. The exact garage locations and prices are not yet confirmed in-game, so use the property listings the game offers and tick them off one by one.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app and this bronze pops at the tenth registration. The Scooter Bros app is the in-game app for registering vehicles, so find vehicles around Leonida, open the app and register each one. The exact steps inside the app are not yet confirmed in-game, so follow the app's own prompts and tick the count off one vehicle at a time.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game
